headlines.title: Trump rolls out red carpets for Xi, though he has portrayed China as a global menace
headlines.description: Just two months ago, President Donald Trump gave a primetime speech accusing China of interfering in the 2020 election.

headlines.title: Netanyahu speech prompts walkout, protests
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s speech at the U.N. prompted walkouts inside the chamber and protests outside. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: It’s cute. It’s cuddly. And it wants all your data.
headlines.description: Meta is touting its new personal AI agent, Muse, as a product “built for everyone” — including those who lack experience with technology.

headlines.title: CNN, MS Now turned away from state dinner event despite court order to restore access
headlines.description: Journalists from CNN and MS Now say they were turned away from the arrivals event of the state dinner that was supposed to be open to the press. This comes despite or court order to restore access to the White House. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris breaks down the details in the case.

headlines.title: Error leads to backlog of tens of thousands of voter registration applications in Texas
headlines.description: County election officials are rushing to deal with the pile of delayed records before early voting begins in the state next month.

headlines.title: Ole Miss identifies 2 students found dead in cases that raise kratom concerns
headlines.description: No definitive link has been made between the drug and the deaths of undergraduate students Aidan Hamilton and Robert Strang, officials said.

headlines.title: Parents call for accountability in daughter’s death
headlines.description: NBC News’ Laura Jarrett reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about a 21-year-old college student who went into the hospital for a broken ankle and ended up dying because of an over prescription of painkillers. Her parents say the system is broken and put part of the blame on the push for profit.

headlines.title: McDonald’s leans into AI and new menu items to attract customers
headlines.description: McDonald’s plans to invest $8.5 billion in its new “NEXT" strategy using AI technology to modernize restaurants and introducing new menu items to reach more customers. NBC News’ Allie Canal breaks down what the company’s next chapter could look like.

headlines.title: The U.S. economy before and after the Iran war, in five charts
headlines.description: Nearly seven months in, the conflict now casts a cloud of uncertainty — with no end in sight.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Pittsburgh pediatric doctor fatally stabbed and wife wounded in attack as they slept
headlines.description: Elijah Hemingway, 32, was found behind a nearby home and arrested in connection with the stabbings of Dr. Idris Evans and his wife.

headlines.title: New Jersey’s governor calls on her lieutenant governor to resign over ethics report
headlines.description: Gov. Mikie Sherrill said Lt. Gov. Dale Caldwell’s “ethical lapses persisted despite multiple warnings and trainings.”
